credanta.name: Credanta
credanta.tagline: Multi-tenant certificate lifecycle management for enterprise PKI.

problem.headline: Certificate management is complex, fragmented and risky.
points: Thousands of certificates across multiple CAs

solution.headline: One platform for the complete certificate lifecycle.
solution.summary: Manage private PKI, public CAs and AD CS through a single, automated platform.

benefits.headline: Lower risk. Less effort. Greater control.
points: Scale PKI across teams and customers

dpdp-shield.name: DPDP Shield
dpdp-shield.tagline: A privacy operations platform for India's DPDP Act.

problem.headline: Consent is easy to collect. Proving and honouring it is harder.
points: Withdrawals fail to reach every data owner
Deletion and retention decisions lack evidence
Rights and grievance requests miss deadlines
Breach response starts without a complete affected-data view
No single record of what data is held, why and for how long

solution.headline: One platform for the complete consent and privacy lifecycle.
solution.summary: Connect consent, data-subject requests, breach workflows and privacy records into one accountable, deadline-driven system.

benefits.headline: Less guesswork. Fewer missed deadlines. Proof at every step.
points: Prove who agreed to what and when
Close the loop on withdrawal and deletion

vulcan.name: Vulcan
vulcan.tagline: AI-driven network monitoring and incident intelligence across existing tools.

problem.headline: Too many monitoring tools. Too many alarms. Too little signal.
points: Every tool has its own console and severity
Cloud-only AIOps is unsuitable for restricted networks

solution.headline: One operational view across the monitoring tools you already run.
solution.summary: Unify alarms, resolve duplicates and identify incidents deserving operator attention — without changing the underlying network.

benefits.headline: Fewer alarms. Faster detection. Better decisions.
points: Audit the reason behind every decision
Adopt safely without changing source systems

cop-ai.name: CopAI
cop-ai.tagline: An AI investigation workspace built for Indian policing.

problem.headline: Investigations run on paperwork. Paperwork should not slow down justice.
points: Complaints and case facts re-entered manually
Multiple investigation documents drafted from scratch
BNS, BNSS & BSA 2023 require current references
Statutory timelines are easy to miss
Evidence and custody paperwork can fail procedural scrutiny
Limited traceability of drafting and approval

solution.headline: One workspace from complaint to charge sheet.
solution.summary: Structure case information, draft investigation documents in departmental formats and keep legal and approval steps traceable.

benefits.headline: Less paperwork. Fewer lapses. Stronger cases.

cctv-investigation-workbench.name: CCTV Investigation Workbench
cctv-investigation-workbench.tagline: Turns existing police CCTV footage into searchable vehicle, person and camera-health records that investigators can question in plain English.

problem.headline: Hours of footage. Limited time. Too much to search manually.
points: Low-resolution footage makes plates difficult to read
False automated matches can lead to wrongful action
Cross-camera movement is difficult to reconstruct

solution.headline: Search, trace and investigate CCTV through one intelligent workspace.
solution.summary: Turn existing camera footage into searchable vehicle, person and camera-health records with plain-English investigation queries.

why.title: Existing Cameras
why.text: Works with current cameras and recorders

benefits.headline: Search faster. Investigate smarter. Use the footage you already have.
points: Reduce false alerts and unnecessary matches

crucible.name: Crucible
crucible.tagline: An agentic workspace for intelligent enterprise automation.

problem.headline: AI tools work in silos. Your business does not.
points: Every AI tool has its own context
Cross-system work still needs people to carry it between tools
New automations often require custom engineering
Limited visibility and control over AI actions

solution.headline: One workspace to connect systems, run agents and automate work.
solution.summary: Use ready-to-deploy agents, workflow automation and multi-agent orchestration in one controlled workspace.

benefits.headline: More automation. Better control. Less context switching.
points: Extend the platform with custom workflows
Run AI where your data and infrastructure live

mukeradb.name: MukeraDB
mukeradb.tagline: A managed MySQL 8.4 LTS platform with built-in resilience and control.

problem.headline: Database operations are fragmented. Recovery is often untested.
points: Replication, backup and monitoring managed separately
Teams want standard MySQL without losing infrastructure control

solution.headline: One control plane to operate, protect and recover MySQL.
solution.summary: Standard MySQL with automated failover, backup, monitoring, hardening and centralized fleet management.

useCases: On-Premise Environments Without Cloud DB Services

benefits.headline: Resilient databases. Consistent operations. Full control.
points: Keep workloads on your own infrastructure
